lines: The home of Ukrainian debate clubs: find a club, register for a session, debate — and follow standings and your own results in one place. Free for every Ukrainian club, run by the Debate Federation of Ukraine.
Registering for a session needs no account — the club shares one link. Sign in to keep your history, schedule and personal stats.

blocks.text: One page for everyone: signed out it opens with the welcome; signed in the welcome goes and only banners are added (see the user column). Read from cab's own records only (club rows, member counts, each club's current session) — no engine call. Next session in words: time — register (or registration open without a time), registration closed, running — watch rooms, not planned yet.
